stories.summary: Nebius plans to spend $40 billion expanding its AI infrastructure, financing the buildout through customer prepayments and loans. Delays at a Microsoft data centre are raising questions about whether that financing model can support the company's planned expansion.

stories.title: Trump Says He Wants to 'Clean Out' Gaza, Send Refugees to Egypt and Jordan
stories.summary: Donald Trump proposed relocating Palestinians from Gaza to Egypt and Jordan, either temporarily or for the long term, while describing the heavily bombed enclave as a demolition site. Arab countries have rejected such displacement proposals since the war began.

stories.title: Kim Jong Un Is Doing Everything He Can to Keep North Korea's Youth in Line
stories.summary: Kim Jong Un is promoting a 300,000-member “shock brigade” of teenagers and young adults drafted into flood reconstruction. The effort is presented as part of his campaign to keep North Korean youth in line and insulate them from Hollywood and K-pop influences.
